note: The request parser copies the attacker-controlled If-Modified-Since header into the helper structure for later parsing.
The helper only proceeds when the captured header has nonzero length, carrying the input string into the time parser.
The parser assumes the input buffer is at least 30 bytes long, but the caller passes a shorter header value without enforcing that minimum size.
The RFC time parser reads fixed offsets from the header string, causing an out-of-bounds read when the supplied header is shorter than the assumed 30-byte format.
